exposure: Estimated blood loss (EBL) during uncomplicated elective caesarean section
cohort: The study included 75 participants who delivered by uncomplicated elective caesarean sections.
finding: The mean 48-hours and 1-week post-operative haemoglobin drops after uncomplicated elective caesarean sections were 1.28 ± 0.09 gms% and 1.3 ± 0.07 gms%, respectively, and these drops did not significantly correlate with estimated blood loss.
